description.value:
You have studied a sister Cloth's art.

Learn one Signature Technique from a Cloth other than your own. Its rank is one lower than your usual Technique rank (minimum rank 1), and it uses your Cosmo DC and focus pool normally.

You may retrain which Technique this is when you gain a level. You cannot select a Cloth's 11th-level Cloth Ability this way — only its Signature Technique.
